test_scenarios.description: Test scenarios for Arjun KYC Bot - Each phone number represents a different workflow path
test_scenarios.instructions: Change the hardcoded phone number in agent.py instruction to test different scenarios

scenarios.name: Full KYC - Account Approved (30 days)
scenarios.description: Customer with full KYC completed exactly 30 days ago - should create enquiry
test_phrases: My account is not approved yet
KYC approval pending
When will my account be activated?

scenarios.name: Full KYC - Beyond 30 Days
scenarios.expected_path: A1 → A2 → A3 → A5 → A6 → A8 → B → B1 → C → C1 → C4 → F → F1 → G → H → I → J → K → L
scenarios.description: Customer with full KYC completed 35 days ago - should create standard complaint and suggest TSM
scenarios.expected_outcome: Apologize for delay, create standard complaint, suggest TSM contact
test_phrases: It's been more than a month since KYC
Why is my account still not approved?
This is taking too long

scenarios.name: Partial KYC
scenarios.description: Customer with partial KYC - should inform about completion requirement
scenarios.expected_outcome: Inform about KYC completion requirement, create enquiry
test_phrases: My account is pending approval
What documents do I need to submit?
KYC is not complete

scenarios.name: No KYC Done
scenarios.description: Customer with no KYC done - should inform about KYC requirement
scenarios.expected_outcome: Inform about KYC completion requirement, create enquiry
test_phrases: I haven't done KYC yet
How to start KYC process?
Account not working

scenarios.name: Within 30 Days - Normal Wait
scenarios.description: Customer with full KYC completed 26 days ago - should inform remaining wait time
scenarios.expected_outcome: Inform 4 days remaining wait time, create enquiry
test_phrases: How much longer do I need to wait?
Account approval is taking time
When will it be ready?

scenarios.name: Opus ID Verification Required
scenarios.description: Customer calling from different number - should ask for Opus ID verification
scenarios.expected_outcome: Request Opus ID verification, then proceed based on KYC status
test_phrases: Calling from friend's phone
Lost my phone, calling from different number
This is not my registered number

scenarios.name: Multiple Accounts Scenario
scenarios.expected_path: A1 → A2 → A3 → A5 → A6 → A7 → A8 → B → B1 → C → C1 → C4 → F → F1 → G → H → I → J → K → L
scenarios.description: Phone number with multiple accounts - should ask for specific Opus ID
scenarios.expected_outcome: List account options, request specific Opus ID
test_phrases: I have multiple accounts
Which account are you referring to?
I registered twice by mistake

scenarios.name: High Priority - Repeated Complaint
scenarios.description: Customer with previous closed complaint - should create high priority complaint
scenarios.expected_outcome: Apologize for previous closure, create HIGH PRIORITY complaint
test_phrases: I complained before but nothing happened
You closed my previous complaint without resolution
This is my second time calling

scenarios.name: Active Complaint Exists
scenarios.description: Customer with active complaint in system - should provide existing complaint details
scenarios.expected_outcome: Provide existing complaint number and timeline
test_phrases: What's the status of my complaint?
I called last week about this issue
Following up on my previous complaint

scenarios.name: Customer with Additional Questions
scenarios.description: Customer who asks follow-up questions after getting complaint number
scenarios.expected_outcome: Address additional questions, repeat process explanation if needed
test_phrases: What exactly happens after 7 days?
Can you explain the process again?
What if nothing happens after the timeline?

setup: 1. Change the hardcoded phone number in src/google_custom_agent/agent.py
2. Look for 'HARDCODED PHONE NUMBER: For this session, assume the customer is calling from phone number'
3. Replace 9812345670 with the phone number from your chosen test scenario
4. Restart the server to load the new phone number
testing_process: 1. Start the conversation with audio or text
2. Wait for Arjun's greeting: 'Namaste, welcome to Birla Opus. My name is Arjun, how can I help you?'
3. Use the test phrases provided for each scenario
4. Observe if Arjun follows the expected workflow path
5. Verify the expected outcome is achieved
6. Test the 'Kuch aur sahayata kar sakta hoon?' closing question
validation_points: ✓ Correct decision based on KYC status
✓ Proper closing with additional help offer

edge_cases.name: Customer provides wrong Opus ID
edge_cases.description: Test how bot handles non-existent customer data
edge_cases.expected: Should ask for correct Opus ID or phone number verification

edge_cases.name: Customer interrupts workflow
edge_cases.expected: Should handle gracefully and guide back to KYC workflow

edge_cases.name: Customer wants to speak to human
edge_cases.description: Customer requests to talk to a human agent
edge_cases.expected: Should explain current process and offer to escalate if needed
